full_judgment: 10. Ongoing to materials on record it transpires that on 06-04-1997 the plaintiff instituted the suit averring that he is in possession in suit land but the defendant-Government wrongly enlisted the some as vested and non-resident property. It is pertinent to point out that the trial of the suit has already been concluded and the same is fixed for judgment. Significantly P.W. 1 was examined on 04-10-2003 wherein he I categorically stated that the plaintiff is in possession in the suit land and the defendant nos.4-6 are not in possession. P.W. 2 and P.W-3 were examined on 18-11-2003 to corroborate the evidence of P. W.1. They corroborated the evidence of P.W-1 regarding possession, but they stated nothing about the dispossession of plaintiff won 01-01-2002. The defendants also examined four witnesses. They categorically stated regarding their possession in certain portion of suit land. Then, after long lapse of 11 years from the date of institution of the suit for the first time plaintiff disclosed in the application for amendment of plaint dated 17-02-2008 that on 01-01-2002 he was dispossessed by the said defendants IF who are in possession in certain portion of suit land. So by the proposed amendment he prayed for a decree of recovery of khas possession by evicting them from the said portion of suit land. Significantly the plaintiff’s witnesses deposed before the trial court after alleged dispossession but they stated nothing about dispossession, rather they asserted their possession in suit land.
